entities.summary: Robert Herbert Forsch was an American professional baseball pitcher. He played 16 seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the St. Louis Cardinals and Houston Astros. He was a member of the 1982 World Series champions and National League (NL) pennant winners in 1985 and 1987.
